Name: NewShortcuts (Beta)
Author: Akshat1422
Description:
New Shortcuts to help the player get to places faster, currently it adds 2(or 4 four if you count the way back).
1: on the beach if you go left, it will take you near leah's house in the forest.
2: if you follow the river up in the tidy pools it would take you to town near the museum
This mod has not been tested due to my laptop having technical issues, so i would appreciate feedback on the cuts and how to make it better, new places to add more cuts and also any issues that may arise due to this.
